title: Gluten-Free Cobb Salad with Chicken, Bacon and Avocado
summary: A classic American Cobb salad with crisp lettuce, juicy chicken, smoky bacon, egg and creamy avocado. It’s fresh, filling and ideal for a quick lunch.
steps: Season the chicken breast with half the salt and black pepper. Cook in a hot pan with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil for 5 to 6 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
Cook the bacon in a separate pan over medium heat until crisp, then drain on kitchen paper and roughly chop.
Boil the eggs for 9 to 10 minutes for hard-boiled yolks. Cool under cold water, peel and quarter.
In a large bowl or on a platter, arrange the lettuce, cherry tomatoes, cucumber and red onion.
Add the sliced chicken, bacon, eggs and avocado on top.
Whisk the remaining olive oil, lemon juice, mustard, and the remaining salt and black pepper to make a simple dressing. Drizzle over the salad and serve immediately.
